title: Supreme Art — Pharmaceutical Packaging & Printing
description: Supreme Art manufactures pharmaceutical folding cartons — printed, die-cut, folded and glued in-house in Peshawar, Pakistan.

hero.title: Supreme Art
hero.tagline: The box your medicine comes in.

about.heading: A pharmaceutical carton maker, from prepress to pallet.
about.text: Supreme Art is a Peshawar-based manufacturer of pharmaceutical folding cartons — the printed paper boxes that carry tablets, syrups, blisters and vials. We run the entire process in-house, so your artwork becomes a finished, machine-ready carton without ever leaving our floor.
points: Offset printing, die-cutting, folding & gluing in-house
Pharma-grade board with full batch traceability
Short runs through to full production volumes

products.heading: Folding cartons for every dosage form.
products.lead: From tablets to syrups, we produce the full range of pharmaceutical secondary packaging.

items.title: Tablet & capsule cartons
items.text: Blister and strip packs, tamper-evident closures.

items.title: Syrup & liquid cartons
items.text: Bottle cartons with partitions and inserts.

items.title: Leaflets & inserts
items.text: Folded package inserts and outer sleeves.

quality.heading: Built for pharma standards.
quality.text: Medicine packaging doesn't get second chances. We run documented quality assurance across every stage — incoming board, colour control on press, dimensional checks after die-cutting, and final inspection before dispatch.

clients.heading: Our clients.
clients.lead: Pharmaceutical and consumer brands that rely on Supreme Art for their packaging.
